title: Club Membership: early-termination fee eligibility and minimum term basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership determines whether an early-termination fee applies at all: the minimum committed term, the timing test against that term, and the relocation-based waiver criterion.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Minimum committed term | Tier's listed early-termination fee | Relocation radius for the waiver criterion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 12 months | $149.00 | 50 miles |
| Student Metro Access | 1 month | $0.00 | 50 miles |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 12 months | $129.00 | 50 miles |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 12 months | $149.00 | 50 miles |
| Premier All-Access | 12 months | $179.00 | 75 miles |
| Black Card All-Access | 12 months | $199.00 | 75 miles |
| Founding Legacy Access | 1 month | $0.00 | 50 miles |

Across every tier, a documented relocation is a case for the relocation-based waiver criterion only where that relocation is beyond the tier's own relocation radius shown above.

## Eligibility: within the minimum term
An early-termination fee charge is billed only when the customer gives notice of this cancellation before the tier's own minimum committed term has elapsed since the membership was opened. The minimum term is counted as full calendar months from the date the membership was opened, completing on that same day-of-month in the ending month (or on the last day of that month where the opening day-of-month does not exist in it). The charge may not apply at a moment later than the membership's opened date plus the tier's own minimum term; that boundary itself is excluded, so notice given exactly at that boundary no longer qualifies.

## Retired clause: relocation waiver no longer applied within this eligibility test
The clause stating that the early-termination fee is waived entirely where the relocation-waiver basis applies to a documented relocation beyond the tier's own relocation radius is no longer in force as a branch of this eligibility test. A documented relocation beyond the tier's own relocation radius is now applied as a separate full waiver of the resulting charge, entered on its own as a dues waiver, rather than as a branch inside the fee eligibility or amount determination; this basis document's own eligibility test above governs only the minimum-term timing, and no longer itself waives the charge on relocation grounds.

## Points of judgement
Notice of cancellation given on the day the minimum term completes, under the same-day-of-month counting basis above, falls exactly on the excluded boundary and does not qualify for the early-termination fee; notice given one full calendar day before that boundary still falls within the minimum term and does qualify.

superseded_clauses: the fee is waived entirely when relocation_termination_fee_waived applies to a documented relocation beyond relocation_radius_miles
